d: The Business Development Manager will play a pivotal role in driving the firm's growth by identifying and securing business opportunities within the GCC insurance sector. The purpose of the role is to enhance the firm's market presence, build lasting client relationships, and increase revenue by offering tailored consultancy services to insurance companies, brokers, and other stakeholders in the industry. The BDM will act as a bridge between client needs and the firm's service offerings, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and industry demands.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Insurance, or a related field.
A professional certifications (e.g., CII, CPCU) is required.
Minimum of 7 years of experience in business development, sales, or a related role within the insurance sector.
Proven track record of generating revenue and closing deals with insurance companies, brokers, or loss adjusters.
Strong understanding of the GCC insurance industry, including regulatory frameworks, market trends, and operational processes.
Goal-oriented, self-motivated, and driven to succeed in a competitive environment.
Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to identifying and solving challenges.
Team player with the ability to collaborate across departments and lead initiatives.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build lasting relationships.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and proposal writing abilities.
Analytical mindset to assess market opportunities and client needs effectively.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM tools.
r: Develop and implement a business development strategy tailored to the insurance sector, aligning with the firm’s overall goals.
Identify and prioritize target markets and client segments within the insurance sector.
Proactively identify, qualify, and secure new clients within the insurance sector.
Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers at insurance companies, brokers, and other industry stakeholders.
Represent the firm at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to promote services.
Monitor industry trends, regulatory changes, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.
Provide insights and recommendations to adapt services to meet evolving client needs and market demands.
Prepare high-quality proposals, presentations, and service agreements tailored to client needs.
Lead contract negotiations, ensuring alignment with company policies and profitability goals.
Work closely with internal teams, including consulting, marketing, and operations, to ensure seamless delivery of services.
Provide feedback from clients to refine service offerings and improve client satisfaction.
Set and achieve business development targets and KPIs, reporting regularly to senior management.
Maintain accurate records of all sales activities, prospects, and client interactions using CRM systems.

d: We are recruiting on behalf of our client, an established consumer electronics retailer in Kuwait, seeking a creative and confident TikTok Content Creator & Presenter to become one of the faces of its brand.

The ideal candidate understands what captures attention on TikTok, enjoys being on camera, and can turn smartphones, gadgets, and everyday technology into engaging, relatable content for Kuwaiti audiences.
q: 2–3 years of experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or similar platforms.
Strong on-camera presence, communication skills, and creativity.
Fluent spoken Arabic, particularly the Kuwaiti dialect , with good English communication skills.
Strong understanding of Kuwaiti culture, consumer behavior, and social media trends.
Genuine interest in smartphones, gadgets, and consumer technology.
An active TikTok account or portfolio demonstrating previous on-camera work.
This is primarily a content creation and on-camera presentation role. Professional filming and video editing are handled by an in-house videographer.
r: Develop original TikTok content ideas, concepts, and recurring video series.
Present engaging product demonstrations, reviews, and technology-related content on camera.
Represent the brand through a natural, confident, and relatable on-screen personality.
Identify relevant TikTok trends and adapt them to the Kuwaiti market.
Collaborate with the in-house videographer and marketing team to bring content ideas to life.
Ensure content reflects the brand's identity and resonates with its target audience.

Control inventory levels, forecasting, and replenishment

Lead, train, and schedule warehouse and logistics teams
